turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I take my dog on a long hike?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Most healthy adult dogs love it. How old is your dog, and what breed?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She's a three year old border collie.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect, collies have tons of energy. She'll probably outlast you. Just build up the distance gradually.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What does she need to bring?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Water and a collapsible bowl, some treats, and poo bags. Check her paws during breaks, rocky trails can hurt them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: keep her on the lead the whole time?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Check the trail rules first. Near livestock or wildlife, a lead is always the safer choice.
